## VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig class

Represents one Vault V2's BluePublicAllocator configuration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig implements IVaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig
```
**Implements:** [IVaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig](./blue-sdk.ivaultv2bluepublicallocatorconfig.md)

## Example


```ts
import { VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";

const config = new VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig({
  vault: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
  canPullFromIdle: true,
  penalty: 500_000_000_000_000_000n,
});
```
